exposure: subcutaneous fat necrosis of the newborn (SCFN)
cohort: Infants diagnosed with SCFN at Ann & Robert H. Lurie Children's Hospital of Chicago from 2009 to 2019
finding: Hypercalcemia occurred in all infants with SCFN who had laboratory monitoring, and those with peak ionized calcium levels below 1.5 mmol/L were less likely to develop complications.
birth_weight: Normal weight for gestational age in 69% of infants
